idea-plugin.name: ChangeLog Pro
idea-plugin.description:
Professional Changelog Management for IntelliJ IDEA

ChangeLog Pro helps you maintain professional, well-structured changelogs following the Keep a Changelog standard and Semantic Versioning principles.

Key Features

  • Universal Git Support - Works with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, Gogs, and any Git repository
  • Multi-Step Wizard - Guided changelog entry creation with validation and preview
  • Issue Tracker Integration - JIRA, GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues, YouTrack, Linear, Azure Boards, and more
  • Auto-Detection - Automatically detects your Git provider and suggests appropriate settings
  • Keep a Changelog Format - Follows the industry-standard changelog format with six change types
  • Git Integration - Automatic staging of changelog files after creation
  • Fragment-Based Approach - Each change is a separate file, preventing merge conflicts
  • Comprehensive Documentation - Built-in help explaining changelog best practices

Change Types Supported

  • Added - New features
  • Changed - Changes in existing functionality
  • Deprecated - Soon-to-be removed features
  • Removed - Now removed features
  • Fixed - Bug fixes
  • Security - Vulnerability fixes

Getting Started

  1. Open the ChangeLog Pro panel from the right sidebar
  2. Click "Initialize Project" to set up the changelog structure
  3. Use "New Entry" or Quick Add buttons to create changelog entries
  4. Entries are saved as YAML files in .changes/unreleased/

Why Keep a Changelog?

A changelog makes it easier for users and contributors to see precisely what notable changes have been made between each release. It's for humans, not machines.
